name: OlapCube
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Independent full-size read of p0/a1/p50/p100 (960x540 lite), no strip. Projected acrylic cube with lit faces, cyan focus slab over dim cells, upright shaped Arabic axis titles, Latin members in mono, Sigma on the rolled-up axis, no numerals, tokens only. Non-blocking: p0 empty, a1 has no labels, axis-0 member ticks drift ~60 px below the cube floor edge (p50), unfocused cells very faint so seeded heat is not visible, no camera drift/parallax, slice/dice/rollup/drill motion unjudged (no strip).
